about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Roadshow began 10 Nov at $70 to $78 a share for 825m shares; pricing expected 18 Nov and first trade 19 Nov (not re-verified on 12 Nov).
Talks ended 11 Nov after two days; US-side reports of a large prisoner exchange with numbers still to be finalised; overnight strikes continued.
Rubio says no need for major combat operations; US tanker removed from RAF Mildenhall after a threat; Iran warns of strikes on US bases.
Burnham said on 9 Nov that no decision had been made; reports of a cut to about 60% for 2030; outcome of the 11 Nov meeting not confirmed.
Eisenkot has the mandate to form a government but cancelled a meeting with Likud on 11 Nov; mandate runs to 6 Dec.
Brazil package carries the 2027 front-wing concept; more aero updates expected in Las Vegas.
Antonelli has the drivers' title and Mercedes the constructors'; Las Vegas on 19 to 21 Nov, then Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

threads.topic: Nvidia board probe of Jensen Huang
threads.status: Independent committee investigating; Nvidia hired former SDNY acting US attorney Joon H. Kim to lead it, per reports.
Anthropic Mythos 5.2, OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber and Google Gemini 4 Carbon all have restricted cyber variants.
Runs to 20 Nov; Guterres warned of mutually assured destruction on 11 Nov.
BMA consultants voted for a 48-hour strike at the end of November; Burnham says there is no money but offers talks.
Brussels summit on 20 Nov on a narrower reset covering food, energy and youth mobility.
